title: The Wobbly Story Rug
markdown:
Once, by a cheerful brook, lived Lottie the duck and Otis the otter. Their friend Rhianedd the hedgehog was the most helpful helper! Tonight, wise Grandpa Moss the badger was coming to tell a story.

A wrinkle, a wiggle, a story to start!

“Is he here yet?” Lottie quacked, tapping her feet.

“Not quite!” Otis whispered. “But Rhianedd is making the story hall ready!”

Rhianedd rolled out a long, stripy rug. A big wrinkle appeared. It felt bumpy, smelling like old wool.

“Ooh! A sleepy caterpillar!” Lottie chirped.

“Or a fluffy cloud’s rest spot!” Otis grinned.

Rhianedd nudged the rug. Another wrinkle wiggled.

“A wiggly worm dancing!” Lottie clapped.

“Or a river’s shortcut!” Otis giggled.

Rhianedd tried to smooth it, but another hump appeared.

“A ladybug picnic hill!” Lottie exclaimed.

“Or a dream train track!” Otis chuckled.

Rhianedd’s efforts made waiting a fun game!

Then Grandpa Moss arrived.

“I heard happy laughter!” he rumbled. “What adventures were you imagining?”

“Sleepy caterpillars, cloud seats, dancing worms, shortcut rivers, picnic hills, and dream trains!” Lottie and Otis chorused.

Grandpa Moss smiled.

“What delightful ideas! Your imaginations started the story!”

He sat on the wonderfully wrinkled rug. Lottie and Otis snuggled close. The rug was a doorway to adventures!

A wrinkle, a wiggle, a story to start — and Grandpa Moss told it from the bumpy, stripy, wonderful rug, while Rhianedd the hedgehog listened with her spines all pleased.
